evidence: Registered with name/email/password(12 chars)/location; toast "Account created successfully!" shown; header now shows Sell button and "Tim Seller" account button indicating signed-in session.

Submitting empty form kept focus on required Title field (native "Please fill out this field" validation). actual: On the My Listings page, each owned listing only exposes "View", "Mark Sold", and "Delete" actions. Sellers have no way to modify title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status of an existing listing.

evidence: Clicking "Mark Sold" changed status badge to "Sold" and button to "Mark Available" with toast "Item marked as sold"; clicking "Mark Available" reverted to "Active" with toast "Item marked as available". Clicking "Delete" opened an alertdialog "Delete listing? This action cannot be undone..." with Cancel/Delete buttons; confirming showed toast "Listing deleted" and the listing immediately disappeared from My Listings (now showing "No listings yet").

Attempting login with an unregistered email "nonexistent.user.qa@example.com" produced toast "Invalid credentials. Try: emma@example.com" and the page remained on /login with header still showing signed-out state (no session created).

Registered "tim.seller.qa@example.com" earlier. Immediately after submitting the duplicate-email registration, a toast "An account with this email already exists" appeared without navigation delay, and the registration form remained fully populated and available (Full Name, Email, Password, Location fields retained their entered values) for correction.

actual: Registered account tim.seller.qa@example.com with password "secretpw". Logging in with the same email but incorrect password "wrongpassword" succeeded: toast "Welcome back!" appeared, user was redirected to home page, and header showed the authenticated "Tim Seller" account button — a signed-in session was created despite the wrong password.

evidence: Viewing own listing (prod-1787576677362/prod-1787576763624) as owner showed a "Manage Your Listings" button and My Listings page exposed View/Mark Sold/Delete controls. Viewing another seller's listing (prod-1, owned by "Emma Green") while signed in as Tim Seller shows only "Add to Cart" and "Message Seller" buttons — no seller-management controls (no manage/edit/sold/delete options) are exposed.

Signed in as Tim Seller, added prod-1 "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" (owned by Emma Green, not Tim) to cart via "Add to Cart". Cart page shows 1 item with title, photo, location "Brooklyn, NY", price $285, and Total $285.00, matching the listing exactly.

On product detail page for prod-1, clicking "Message Seller" opened a dialog "Send a message to Emma Green" with a textbox and a "Send Message" button that was disabled while the textbox was empty. After typing a non-empty message ("Hi Emma, is this armchair still available? I'd love to purchase it."), the Send Message button became enabled; clicking it produced toast "Message sent to seller!" and the dialog closed, confirming successful submission of a non-empty purchase-related message to the seller.

issue: Seller has no way to view purchase requests or buyer messages
actual: Signed in as Marcus Chen, added Emma Green's listing "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" (prod-1) to cart and submitted it via "Send Purchase Request" (toast "Purchase requests sent to sellers!" confirmed submission). Logged out and logged in as the seller, Emma Green. On My Listings, the "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" listing shows only status "Active" with View/Mark Sold/Delete actions — no indicator of a pending purchase request, no request count/badge, and no way to open or read the buyer's request. The header account menu (My Profile/My Listings/Log out) and the header icon buttons (search, cart) contain no "Requests" or "Messages"/inbox section anywhere in the app. There is no UI surface for a seller to view requested items or buyer messages.

issue: Unauthenticated access to protected route renders blank page instead of redirecting/prompting login
actual: While signed out, navigating to the /cart route directly renders a completely blank page (only the empty notification regions are present in the DOM — no header, no cart content, no login prompt, no redirect to /login). The browser console shows a React warning "You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered," confirming the app attempts an improper navigate() call to guard the route but fails to actually redirect or block access gracefully, leaving the user on a broken blank page instead of being redirected to sign in.
evidence: Console warning: "You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered." at react-router-dom.js. Snapshot of /cart while signed out shows only 'region Notifications (F8)' and 'region Notifications alt+T' with no other content.

Marked Emma Green's listing "Handmade Macrame Wall Hanging" (prod-5) as sold via My Listings "Mark Sold" (toast "Item marked as sold", status badge changed to "Sold"). On the Browse page, the "items available" count immediately dropped from 10 to 9 and the sold item no longer appeared in the browse grid. Searching for "macrame" (its title keyword) returned "0 items available" / "No items found" — the sold item is excluded from search results too. Viewing its product detail page directly shows "This item is no longer available" with no purchase controls (Add to Cart / Message Seller) available — only "Manage Your Listings" for the owner. Clearing the search restored the count to 9 items (still correctly excluding the sold item), confirming sold listings are consistently excluded from browse and search and cannot be purchased.

Search is case-insensitive and matches across title, description, and location fields. "SAGE GREEN" (uppercase) matched prod-1 "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" via its description text "...sage green velvet...". "brooklyn" (lowercase) matched prod-1 via its location "Brooklyn, NY". Clearing the search box restores the full unfiltered list (9 items, correctly excluding the previously sold-marked prod-5).

Search results update live/immediately upon typing without requiring Enter or a submit button. Confirmed across multiple terms: "macrame" instantly showed 0 items/"No items found", "SAGE GREEN" instantly showed 1 matching item, "brooklyn" instantly showed 1 matching item, and clearing the box instantly restored 9 items.

Combined filters and sort work correctly together. Category "Furniture" alone: 9→3 items (all furniture items). Adding condition "Like New" on top: 3→1 item (only Mid-Century Modern Armchair, which is both Furniture and Like New). After clearing and sorting by "Price: Low to High": all 9 items correctly ordered $35→$320. Adding "Upcycled items only" filter on top of that sort: correctly narrowed to 4 upcycled items ($125, $175, $285, $320) still in ascending price order. All filter/sort combinations produced correct intersected, correctly-ordered results.

issue: "Clear all filters" does not fully restore the unfiltered item list when a search term is active
actual: Checkbox/slider filter changes do update the result list live/immediately (e.g., checking "Furniture" instantly narrowed 9→3 items; combined with search text "lamp" instantly narrowed to 0 items). However, clicking "Clear all filters" only resets the checkbox/slider filter controls — it does NOT clear the search box text. After searching "lamp" + checking "Furniture" (0 items/"No items found"), clicking "Clear all filters" unchecked Furniture but left "lamp" in the search box, leaving the view showing only 1 item (Vintage Brass Floor Lamp) instead of restoring the full 9-item unfiltered browse list.
evidence: Steps: searched "lamp" (via search box) + checked "Furniture" category → "0 items available"/"No items found". Clicked "Clear all filters" → Furniture checkbox cleared, but search box still contained "lamp" and list showed only "1 items available" (Vintage Brass Floor Lamp), not the full unfiltered 9-item list.

issue: Category browsing page does not filter results
actual: Clicking the "Furniture" category card (labeled "3 items") on the /categories page navigates to /?category=furniture, but the Browse page shows all 9 items available (unfiltered) and the "Furniture" checkbox in the sidebar filter panel is NOT checked. The category selection from the Categories page has no effect on the actual displayed/filtered results.
evidence: /categories page correctly showed per-category counts (Furniture 3, Clothing 1, Electronics 1, Home Decor 1, Books 1, Sports 1, Toys 1, Other 0, summing to 9). Clicking "Furniture 3 items" navigated to /?category=furniture but Browse page displayed "9 items available" with all 9 unfiltered listings and an unchecked Furniture checkbox.

issue: Availability status is not consistently/explicitly displayed on listing detail pages
actual: Core listing fields (title, price, category badge, condition badge, location with distance, "Listed" date, description, seller name/photo/location, Upcycled badge where applicable) are displayed consistently across all active listing detail pages checked (prod-10, prod-7, prod-5). However, none of these active listings show an explicit availability status label (e.g., "Available"/"Active") — status is only inferable indirectly from the presence of the "Add to Cart"/"Message Seller" buttons. By contrast, a sold listing displays an explicit "This item is no longer available" message with purchase controls removed. This is an inconsistent presentation of the availability status field: explicit for sold items, implicit/absent for active items.
evidence: Checked prod-10 (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf), prod-7 (Yoga Mat & Blocks Set), and prod-5 (Handmade Macrame Wall Hanging) — all active listings show identical field layout with no explicit status text, only action buttons implying availability. Previously observed (FT-4) that a sold listing shows explicit "This item is no longer available" text instead.
